$comment: Machine-readable run-list for the Snake game's bitmap art. Hand this to an image-generating agent. Every string in `prompt` is passed to the model verbatim -- do not paraphrase. Human context and the what/why is in art-assets.md.

tool.name: agy-image
notes: The image model has its own daily quota, separate from any chat quota. On 429 it prints the reset time; wait, do not retry in a loop.
The model paints a solid background, not an alpha channel. Sprites that need transparency are generated on flat magenta #FF00FF and colour-keyed at load time by src/assets.ts.
Output format is chosen by the --out extension. Use .webp.

globalConstraints: No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in any image (a word baked into a PNG is a string the i18n layer cannot translate).
Flat vector / sticker style, clean edges, even flat lighting, no photorealism.
Keep each file small -- it is precached by the service worker and downloaded before the game is playable offline.
public/icon.svg and the catalog `cover` are NOT in this list -- they stay hand-authored vector.

assets.role: Grass board texture, drawn stretched over the whole square board under the snake.
assets.prompt: Top-down grass texture for a game board, flat vector style, two very close shades of bright lime green forming a soft subtle checkerboard, gentle organic mottling, no grass blades, no outlines, even flat lighting, seamless tileable. No text, no letters, no numbers.
assets.command: python3 ~/.claude/skills/agy-image/scripts/agy_image.py --prompt "Top-down grass texture for a game board, flat vector style, two very close shades of bright lime green forming a soft subtle checkerboard, gentle organic mottling, no grass blades, no outlines, even flat lighting, seamless tileable. No text, no letters, no numbers." --aspect 1:1 --resize 512x512 --out games/snake/public/art/field.webp
assets.acceptCheck: Reads as flat grass; no visible seam line through the middle; no lettering.

assets.role: The food, drawn at roughly one grid cell, gently pulsing.
assets.background: flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no shadow on the background
assets.chromaKey: src/assets.ts keys out pixels within distance 64 of #FF00FF
assets.prompt: A single glossy cartoon apple, bright cherry red, one small curved green leaf at the top, one soft white highlight, flat vector sticker style with a thin clean darker-red edge, front view, centered, filling most of the frame, on a solid flat magenta background hex FF00FF, no drop shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers.
assets.command: python3 ~/.claude/skills/agy-image/scripts/agy_image.py --prompt "A single glossy cartoon apple, bright cherry red, one small curved green leaf at the top, one soft white highlight, flat vector sticker style with a thin clean darker-red edge, front view, centered, filling most of the frame, on a solid flat magenta background hex FF00FF, no drop shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers." --aspect 1:1 --resize 128x128 --out games/snake/public/art/apple.webp
assets.postProcess: Background must be an even magenta with no gradient, or the chroma-key leaves a halo.
assets.acceptCheck: Apple fills the frame, background is uniform magenta, no lettering.

assets.role: The mascot on the blue start card.
assets.background: flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no shadow on the background
assets.chromaKey: src/assets.ts keys out pixels within distance 64 of #FF00FF; render draws a soft white halo behind it
assets.prompt: A cute coiled cartoon snake mascot, rounded royal blue hex 3B5BC0 body, big friendly white eyes with dark pupils, small happy smile, curled up resting in a spiral, front view, centered, filling most of the frame, flat vector sticker style with a thin white outline, soft even lighting, on a solid flat magenta background hex FF00FF, no drop shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers.
assets.command: python3 ~/.claude/skills/agy-image/scripts/agy_image.py --prompt "A cute coiled cartoon snake mascot, rounded royal blue hex 3B5BC0 body, big friendly white eyes with dark pupils, small happy smile, curled up resting in a spiral, front view, centered, filling most of the frame, flat vector sticker style with a thin white outline, soft even lighting, on a solid flat magenta background hex FF00FF, no drop shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers." --aspect 1:1 --resize 384x384 --out games/snake/public/art/title.webp
assets.postProcess: Background must be an even magenta with no gradient. The thin white outline helps the blue body read against the blue card.
assets.acceptCheck: Friendly coiled snake, uniform magenta background, thin white outline present, no lettering.

afterGenerating: Eyeball every file: zero text/letters/numbers (testplan S10).
For apple.webp and title.webp confirm the background is a single flat magenta.
Run `pnpm build` from the repo root; confirm dist/g/snake/art/ contains all three (they precache via the `webp` glob, testplan S3).
`git add games/snake/public/art` and commit as task T3.
In games/snake/docs/progress.md: set T3 to done, tick the art parts of testplan M17 and S10.
